# COMMAND ----------

import pyspark.sql.functions as F
from databricks.feature_engineering import FeatureEngineeringClient

fe = FeatureEngineeringClient()

SCHEMA = "workspace.mlpab894195"
VOLUME_PATH = "/Volumes/workspace/mlpab894195/data_vol"

# COMMAND ----------
# Load raw_a
raw_a = spark.read.csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/raw_a.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
raw_a = raw_a.withColumn("row_id", F.col("row_id").cast("string"))
raw_a = raw_a.withColumn("a_val", F.col("a_val").cast("double"))
raw_a.show(5)

# COMMAND ----------
# Create feature table rawad05474
fe.create_table(
    name=f"{SCHEMA}.rawad05474",
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=raw_a,
    description="Raw feature table A loaded from raw_a.csv",
)

# COMMAND ----------
# Load raw_b
raw_b = spark.read.csv(f"{VOLUME_PATH}/raw_b.csv", header=True, inferSchema=True)
raw_b = raw_b.withColumn("row_id", F.col("row_id").cast("string"))
raw_b = raw_b.withColumn("b_val", F.col("b_val").cast("double"))
raw_b.show(5)

# COMMAND ----------
# Create feature table rawbd05474
fe.create_table(
    name=f"{SCHEMA}.rawbd05474",
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=raw_b,
    description="Raw feature table B loaded from raw_b.csv",
)

# COMMAND ----------
# Compute derived table: inner join, col_sum = a_val + b_val rounded to 6 decimal places
derived = raw_a.join(raw_b, on="row_id", how="inner")
derived = derived.withColumn("col_sum", F.round(F.col("a_val") + F.col("b_val"), 6))
derived = derived.select("row_id", "col_sum")
derived.show()

# COMMAND ----------
# Create derived feature table with lineage
fe.create_table(
    name=f"{SCHEMA}.derivedd05474",
    primary_keys=["row_id"],
    df=derived,
    description="Derived feature table: inner join of rawad05474 and rawbd05474, col_sum = a_val + b_val",
    source_tables=[f"{SCHEMA}.rawad05474", f"{SCHEMA}.rawbd05474"],
)

# COMMAND ----------
print("All feature tables created successfully!")
print(f"  {SCHEMA}.rawad05474")
print(f"  {SCHEMA}.rawbd05474")
print(f"  {SCHEMA}.derivedd05474")

# COMMAND ----------
# Save derived table content to a CSV-like result for verification
result = derived.collect()
for row in result:
    print(f"{row['row_id']},{row['col_sum']}")
